title: The Pipeline Refactor
prompt: Implement the decomposed pipeline for expense lines "name,amount": `parse_amount(line)` (double; 0.0 on missing/invalid), `is_valid(line)` (name non-empty AND amount > 0), and `pipeline_total(lines)` (sum of valid amounts). Empty list → 0.0.

tests.name: invalid name
tests.hint: Empty name is invalid even with a good amount.
